name: memorq
description: memorq for Pi: a memory of each repository, notes of facts and corrections written from past sessions. The Claude Code plugin lives in the same folder.

scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && biome lint
scripts.format: uv run ruff format . && biome format --write
scripts.check: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && biome ci && npm run typecheck
scripts.changelog: if git rev-parse -q --verify "refs/tags/v$npm_package_version" >/dev/null; then uvx git-cliff==2.14.2 -o CHANGELOG.md; else uvx git-cliff==2.14.2 --tag "v$npm_package_version" -o CHANGELOG.md; fi
scripts.fonts: FONT_SRC=${FONT_SRC:-/Users/arian/conductor/workspaces/evaluatorq/amsterdam/docs/stylesheets/fonts}; for f in Regular Medium SemiBold; do uvx --from fonttools --with brotli pyftsubset $FONT_SRC/AvioSans-$f.woff2 --flavor=woff2 --layout-features='kern,liga,tnum' --unicodes='U+0020-007E,U+00A0-00FF,U+2013-2014,U+2018-201D,U+2022,U+2026,U+2190-2193,U+25B2,U+25BC,U+2713,U+00D7' --output-file=assets/AvioSans-$f.woff2; done
